steps: Stand tall, then inhale and sweep your arms overhead, exhale and fold forward from the hips.
Step or jump back to a plank, lower down, and press into upward dog or cobra.
Lift into downward dog, hold a few breaths, then step forward and rise to standing.
Sun Salutation Flow.mistake: Rushing between poses and holding the breath instead of linking each move to an inhale or exhale.

steps: From hands and knees, tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back into an upside-down V.
Press your hands into the floor, lengthen your spine, and let your heels reach toward the ground.
Move gently through the flow by bending one knee at a time, breathing steadily.
Downward Dog Flow.mistake: Rounding the back to straighten the legs instead of bending the knees to keep the spine long.

steps: Step one foot back wide, turn the back foot slightly in and bend the front knee over your ankle.
Raise your arms overhead or out to the sides, keeping your torso upright and hips facing the same way.
Hold for several breaths, then flow through to the next warrior and switch sides.
Warrior Sequence.mistake: Letting the front knee collapse inward or drift past the toes.

steps: Kneel with your big toes together and your knees wide apart.
Sit your hips back toward your heels and fold your torso forward between your knees.
Rest your forehead on the floor with your arms extended or by your sides, and breathe slowly.
Child's Pose Rest.mistake: Forcing the hips down when they will not reach, instead of putting a cushion under them.

steps: From downward dog, bring one knee toward your wrist and lay the shin across the mat.
Slide the back leg straight behind you and square your hips to the front.
Fold forward over the front leg and hold, breathing slowly, then switch sides.
Pigeon Pose Hold.mistake: Letting the hips tilt to one side and twisting the front knee instead of supporting the hip with a block.

steps: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders and your elbows tucked in.
Press gently through your hands to lift your chest, keeping your lower body on the floor.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and gaze forward, then lower with control.
Cobra Pose.mistake: Pushing up with the arms until they lock, which dumps the weight into the lower back.

steps: Start on hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders and knees under your hips.
Inhale as you drop your belly and lift your chest, then exhale as you round your spine to the ceiling.
Flow with your breath, moving smoothly through the whole spine.
Cat-Cow Yoga Flow.mistake: Moving quickly without matching your breath, which loses the point of the flow.

steps: Stand tall, shift your weight onto one leg and place the sole of the other foot on your calf or inner thigh.
Press the foot and leg into each other and bring your hands together at your chest or overhead.
Fix your gaze on a still point and hold for several breaths, then switch sides.
Tree Pose.mistake: Resting the foot directly on the side of the knee, which stresses the joint.

steps: Stand with your feet wide, turn the front foot out and keep your torso long.
Reach forward and then hinge sideways over the front leg, resting your hand on your shin or a block.
Open your chest and reach the top arm up, holding for several breaths before switching sides.
Triangle Pose.mistake: Collapsing the chest forward instead of keeping both sides of the torso long.

steps: Stand with your feet together or hip-width apart and your arms overhead.
Bend your knees and sit your hips back as if sitting in a chair.
Keep your chest lifted and weight in your heels, and hold for several breaths.
Chair Pose.mistake: Letting the knees drift past the toes and the lower back arch.

steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart.
Press through your feet to lift your hips, rolling the spine up off the floor.
Keep your thighs parallel, open your chest and hold for several breaths.
Bridge Pose.mistake: Letting the knees splay out or pushing the hips so high that the neck gets compressed.

steps: Kneel with your knees hip-width apart and your hands on your lower back.
Lift your chest and lean back, reaching your hands for your heels if you can.
Keep your hips over your knees and your neck relaxed, then come up slowly.
Camel Pose.mistake: Dropping the head back and pushing the hips behind the knees, which crunches the lower back.

steps: Sit tall with your legs crossed or extended and one hand behind you.
Turn your torso toward the back hand, using the other hand on your knee for gentle leverage.
Lengthen the spine on each inhale and twist a bit further on each exhale, then switch sides.
Seated Twist.mistake: Cranking the spine with the arms instead of twisting from the middle of the back.

steps: Stand on one leg, wrap the other leg around it, and bend your standing knee slightly.
Wrap your arms around each other and lift your elbows to shoulder height.
Sit down a little deeper, hold steadily, then unwind and switch sides.
Eagle Pose.mistake: Holding the breath and gripping tightly, which makes balance harder.

steps: From triangle, bend your front knee and step your back foot in slightly.
Place your front hand on the floor or a block and lift the back leg until it is level with your hip.
Open your chest toward the side, reach the top arm up and hold for several breaths.
Half Moon Pose.mistake: Letting the lifted hip roll forward instead of stacking the hips.

steps: Squat with your hands flat on the floor, shoulder-width apart, and bend your elbows.
Rest your knees on the backs of your upper arms and lean forward, shifting your weight into your hands.
Lift one foot and then the other, hold briefly, and lower down with control.
Crow Pose.mistake: Looking down at your feet and tipping forward onto the face.

steps: Sit with your knees bent and your feet on the floor, leaning back slightly with a long spine.
Lift your feet until your shins are parallel to the floor and reach your arms forward.
Hold for several breaths, then extend the legs straight if you can keep your spine long.
Boat Pose.mistake: Rounding the lower back and collapsing the chest to lift the legs higher.

steps: Lie on your back with your legs together and your hands under your hips.
Press your elbows into the floor and lift your chest, arching your upper back.
Lower the crown of your head gently to the floor, keeping most of the weight on the elbows, and breathe.
Fish Pose.mistake: Dumping the weight onto the head and neck instead of lifting through the chest.

steps: Lie face down with your arms by your sides, palms up, and your forehead on the floor.
Lift your head, chest, arms and legs off the floor together.
Hold for several breaths, keeping your neck in line, then lower.
Locust Pose.mistake: Pushing the legs together and overarching, which squeezes the lower back.

steps: Lie face down, bend your knees and reach back to hold your ankles.
Kick your feet into your hands and lift your chest and thighs off the floor.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower with control.
Bow Pose.mistake: Pulling hard with the arms instead of kicking the feet back to create the lift.

steps: Step into a wide lunge with your front knee bent over your ankle and your back leg straight.
Rest your front forearm on your thigh or your hand on the floor or a block.
Reach your top arm overhead along your ear and hold for several breaths.
Extended Side Angle.mistake: Letting the front knee fall inward or putting weight onto the lower hand.

steps: From warrior II, rest your back hand on your back leg.
Reach your front arm overhead and arch gently back, keeping the front knee bent.
Hold for several breaths, then return to warrior II.
Reverse Warrior.mistake: Leaning on the back leg and letting the front knee collapse in.

steps: Step one foot forward between your hands and lower the back knee to the floor.
Lift your torso and reach your arms overhead as you sink your hips forward.
Hold for several breaths, then flow back to downward dog and switch sides.
Low Lunge Flow.mistake: Letting the front knee drift past the toes instead of stacking it over the ankle.

steps: Step one foot forward between your hands with the back knee lifted and the leg strong.
Rise up, reaching your arms overhead and sinking your hips lower.
Hold for several breaths, then flow back and switch sides.
High Lunge Flow.mistake: Arching the lower back instead of drawing the tailbone down and lifting the ribs.

steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hinge forward from the hips.
Let your head and arms hang, with a soft bend in the knees.
Hold for several breaths, then roll up slowly one vertebra at a time.
Standing Forward Fold.mistake: Locking the knees and hanging from the lower back instead of bending the knees to relax the spine.

steps: Stand with your feet wide and parallel, hands on your hips.
Hinge forward from the hips with a long spine and place your hands on the floor or blocks.
Let your head hang and hold for several breaths, then rise slowly.
Wide-Legged Forward Fold.mistake: Collapsing the back to reach the floor instead of keeping the spine long.

steps: Lie on your back, lift your legs over your head and lower your toes to the floor behind you.
Support your back with your hands or leave your arms on the floor.
Keep your neck relaxed and still, then roll out slowly.
Plow Pose.mistake: Turning the head or loading the neck, which strains it.

steps: Lie on your back, lift your legs overhead and place your hands on your lower back for support.
Straighten your legs to the ceiling, keeping your elbows close.
Keep your neck still and hold for several breaths, then lower slowly.
Shoulder Stand.mistake: Looking around or letting the elbows splay out, which strains the neck.

steps: Lie on your back, bend your knees toward your chest and hold the outsides of your feet.
Open your knees wider than your torso and pull your feet toward the floor.
Rock gently from side to side, relaxing your lower back.
Happy Baby Pose.mistake: Lifting the tailbone off the floor and tensing the neck.

steps: Lie on your back, hug your knees to your chest and open your arms in a T shape.
Drop both knees to one side while keeping your shoulders on the floor.
Turn your head the other way and breathe slowly, then switch sides.
Reclined Twist.mistake: Forcing the knees down while the opposite shoulder lifts off the floor.

steps: Sit sideways next to a wall and swing your legs up as you lie back.
Rest your legs against the wall and your arms by your sides, with your hips close to the wall.
Relax and breathe slowly for several minutes.
Legs-Up-The-Wall.mistake: Sitting too far from the wall, which strains the hamstrings instead of letting them release.

steps: Lie on your back with your legs slightly apart and your arms a little away from your body, palms up.
Close your eyes and relax every muscle, letting your breath settle.
Stay still for several minutes, then roll gently to one side before getting up.
Corpse Pose.mistake: Fidgeting or staying tense, which stops the body from fully relaxing.

steps: Lie face down with your forearms on the floor and your elbows under your shoulders.
Press gently into your forearms and lift your chest, keeping your hips down.
Relax your shoulders away from your ears and breathe slowly.
Sphinx Pose.mistake: Shrugging the shoulders up and crunching the neck.

steps: Start on hands and knees, then lower to your forearms with your elbows under your shoulders.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back, straightening your legs as much as you can.
Press your forearms firmly into the floor and hold for several breaths.
Dolphin Pose.mistake: Letting the shoulders sink into the floor instead of pushing the forearms down.

steps: From a standing forward fold, shift your weight onto one leg.
Lift the other leg straight up behind you as high as you can control.
Keep your hips square and your hands on the floor or blocks, then lower and switch sides.
Standing Split Pose.mistake: Opening the lifted hip to the side and locking the standing knee.

steps: Stand with your feet in a short stance, front foot forward and back foot turned slightly out.
Hinge forward and place the opposite hand outside the front foot, twisting your chest toward the front leg.
Reach the other arm to the ceiling and hold for several breaths, then switch sides.
Revolved Triangle Pose.mistake: Rounding the back and letting the hips twist out of line.

steps: Place the blocks within reach and move through your usual poses.
Use the blocks under your hands or hips wherever the floor feels too far away.
Keep your spine long in each pose and breathe steadily.
Yoga with Block Support Flow.mistake: Using blocks too low, so you still collapse instead of staying long.

steps: Arrange the bolster so your body can rest fully, such as along your spine or under your knees.
Lie back and let your body sink into the support, relaxing your muscles.
Stay in each pose for a few minutes, breathing slowly and deeply.
Restorative Yoga with Bolster.mistake: Holding tension in the shoulders and jaw, which defeats the restorative effect.

steps: Stand next to or facing a wall within arm's reach.
Use your hands or back against the wall for support as you move through your poses.
Let the wall carry some of the load, and focus on a long, relaxed spine.
Wall-Assisted Yoga Flow.mistake: Leaning hard on the wall in every pose instead of using it only for balance.

steps: Hold a strap in your hands and loop it around your foot or hands as each pose needs.
Use the strap to extend your reach, keeping your spine long and your shoulders down.
Hold each stretch for several breaths, easing deeper only as comfortable.
Yoga Strap Stretch Sequence.mistake: Pulling hard on the strap instead of using it to reach a little further each breath.

steps: Arrive hydrated and bring a towel and plenty of water.
Move through the class poses at your own pace, keeping your breathing steady in the heat.
Rest in child's pose whenever you feel lightheaded, and cool down gently afterwards.
Hot Yoga Studio Flow.mistake: Pushing deep into stretches because the heat makes you feel loose, which risks strains.

steps: Set the hammock at hip height and sit into it with the fabric supporting your hips.
Move slowly through the poses, letting the hammock take your weight and keeping your grip relaxed.
Come down gently, then rest in a supported pose before standing.
Aerial Yoga Flow.mistake: Rushing into inversions before getting used to the hammock's movement.
